status: Automated waveform/spectral measurements only; not listening-certified downbeats or lyrical cues.

method.onset: Positive log-magnitude spectral flux, 1024-sample Hann STFT, 220-sample hop (9.98 ms), local peaks separated by >=0.12 s.
method.rms: 100 ms centered RMS, sampled at STFT hop.
method.precision: Onset peaks are approximate spectral-feature centers; practical synchronization tolerance ±0.03 s, not sample-accurate transient starts.
method.drive: 20 Hz. energy and bass normalized to global 98th percentile; onset to 99th percentile. onset_envelope has immediate attack and 0.14 s exponential decay. Linear interpolation recommended; no random jitter.

cues.action: Finish last travelling move on this transient; settle over 0.3–0.6 s. Energy substantially lower by 55.5 s.
Start second pursuit; use 74.421 s for a secondary near-field pass, not a delayed return.
Optional near-field panel edge pass; keep aircraft stable.
Settling cue, not a strong beat. Existing 110.77 storyboard boundary remains suitable.
Enter pre-climax contraction/hold. Do not reveal the full aircraft here.
Start maximum pullback on this return; do not add an arbitrary extra hold after the musical hit.
Pass the foreground frame mid-pullback; complete the pullback around 132.6 s.
Begin gradual deceleration if desired, but keep forward energy until 168.465 s.
Complete the release, then retain only small instrument movements and very slow world motion.
